subject: Upcoming Team Meeting Agenda
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. Please find attached the agenda for our upcoming team meeting scheduled for next Monday. We will be discussing the progress on ongoing projects, upcoming deadlines, and any challenges that need to be addressed. Your active participation and input are highly appreciated. If you have any specific topics you would like to add to the agenda, please let me know by Friday. Looking forward to a productive meeting. Best regards, [Your Name]
